title: Hand-labeled coding-agent memory retrieval development benchmark
description: Synthetic facts and queries written for development. These are retrieval queries, not unseen tasks or end-to-end coding tasks. Relevance labels are manually authored and should be independently reviewed before a final project evaluation.

memories.content: Runtime target: CPython 3.12. Generated Python code must remain compatible with Python 3.12.
HTTP API framework: FastAPI. Route handlers live in app/routes.py.
Durable agent memory uses SQLite with the FTS5 extension, stored locally without a database server.
Embeddings are optional. Offline retrieval must continue using keyword search when the embedding provider is unavailable.
Run the regression suite with python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Formatting convention: use four spaces for indentation; avoid tab characters in source files.
Static lint command: ruff check agent_roles memory tests.
Sign-in design uses OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with PKCE and an external identity provider.
Transient HTTP 429 responses receive exponential backoff with at most three retry attempts.
Terminal observations are truncated to 4000 characters before entering the prompt; full logs stay in artifacts.
The execution sandbox denies outbound network connections. Install required packages before starting it.
Dependency versions are pinned in requirements.txt; use pip to install them into a virtual environment.
OpenRouter request timeout is 30 seconds.
OpenRouter request timeout is 60 seconds.
Temporary debugging endpoint listens on port 9229.
The application cache is Redis on port 6379.
The abandoned Zephyr release plan uses the comet deployment target.
Project Mercury uses Kubernetes for deployment.
Alice prefers the editor theme to use dark colours.
Bob prefers the editor theme to use light colours.
Reviewer-only audit note: inspect overflow handling in the invoice calculator.
Session s1 temporary investigation concerns the atlas parser regression.
Task t1 checkpoint: migrate the nebula serializer after its failing test is reproduced.
Credentials must never be copied into saved memory or application logs.
Previous ModuleNotFoundError for requests was fixed by installing requirements.txt in the active virtual environment.
EADDRINUSE occurred because an old development server still held port 8000. Stop that process before restarting.
Comparing naive and timezone-aware datetime values raised TypeError. Normalise timestamps to UTC before comparisons.
Superseding a stored fact and inserting its replacement must occur in one atomic transaction.
Conversation compaction must preserve each assistant tool call together with its matching tool result.
The test suite might include an undocumented GPU benchmark; this model suggestion has not been verified.
